question: Bihar district wise full vaccination change from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5 in percentage points

    SELECT 
        District, 
        "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs4_vaccinated
    FROM district_health_factsheet

        AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4'
        AND District != 'State Total'
),
nfhs5 AS (
    SELECT 
        District, 
        "Children age 12-23 months fully vaccinated (%)" AS nfhs5_vaccinated
    FROM district_health_factsheet
    WHERE State = 'Bihar' 
        AND "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5'
        AND District != 'State Total'
)
SELECT 
    nfhs4.District,
    nfhs4.nfhs4_vaccinated,
    nfhs5.nfhs5_vaccinated,
    (nfhs5.nfhs5_vaccinated - nfhs4.nfhs4_vaccinated) AS vaccination_change_pp
FROM nfhs4
JOIN nfhs5 ON nfhs4.District = nfhs5.District
ORDER BY nfhs4.District;
